note: native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
activity bar and bottom-left action bar -- renders fixed operator icons: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
search viewlet header -- renders fixed operator label 'Search' and fixed action buttons: Refresh, Clear, New Editor, List, Collapse
search input controls -- renders fixed operator widgets: search box, case sensitive, whole word, regex toggles
search details toggle -- renders fixed operator control
search status message -- renders fixed operator copy: 'No results found' and 'Clear Search' link
editor tab bar chrome -- renders fixed operator controls: close, split, more; the active tab is the operator's built-in 'Getting Started' page
getting started page -- renders fixed operator documentation: product name, subtitle, quick start actions, and built-in tutorial categories
status bar -- renders fixed operator status indicators: remote connection, SCM state, problems count, ports, notifications, screen reader mode
